dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.cowardly.desc: Bolts at the first sign of danger and keeps running long after it has passed.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.curious.descr: Drifts toward staff and anything left lying around. Eyes everything.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.lazy.descript: Turns in early, sleeps late and will not bend down for loose items.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.restless.desc: Paces the whole wing and rarely settles before midnight.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.combative.des: Fights back when struck. Will raise a shield if handed one.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.obedient.desc: Follows the nearest staff member at a polite distance.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.paranoid.desc: Constantly checks over both shoulders and keeps staff at arm's length.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.stoic.descrip: Unmoved by most hazards. Rarely flees and eats only when it must.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.gluttonous.de: Eats whenever possible and collects food from the floor.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.sociable.desc: Seeks out other Class-D personnel during idle hours.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.insomniac.des: Does not sleep. Wanders the dark corridors instead.
dclass.scp_unleashed.trait.cheerful.desc: Hums, smiles at staff and wanders over to say hello.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.smuggling.des: Moved goods past three borders. Still hoards anything not nailed down.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.grand_theft.d: Took a freight truck, its cargo and the loading dock clock.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.arson.descrip: Set fire to a warehouse of decommissioned fireworks.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.fraud.descrip: Sold the same lighthouse to four separate buyers.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.desertion.des: Walked away from a remote posting and kept walking.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.sabotage.desc: Rewired a factory line to produce only left shoes.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.counterfeitin: Printed convincing banknotes in an unconvincing currency.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.burglary.desc: Entered eleven homes and left each one tidier than before.
Ran a protection scheme for vending machines.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.espionage.des: Photographed classified documents with a toy camera.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.assault.descr: Started a brawl over the last seat on a ferry.
dclass.scp_unleashed.crime.vandalism.des: Repainted a city statue in protest colours, twice.
effect.scp_unleashed.anti_memetic.descri: Certain memetic and antimemetic influences cannot take hold of you. It does not protect against everything.
